name: abdurahmon-madrasa-ecosystem
description: Abdurahmon ibn Avf madrasasi — Telegram ekotizim (Bot + Mini App + Admin panel)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,miniapp,admin -c green,yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w miniapp" "npm run dev -w admin"
scripts.build: prisma generate && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w miniapp && npm run build -w admin
